catalysts.headline: Raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $410M–$420M (as carried on file)
catalysts.impact: Could not be independently confirmed this session before the search budget was exhausted. Note: as of the Aug 6, 2026 Q2 report, Iovance had said it was reviewing its prior FY2026 guidance of $350M–$370M and would provide an update during Q3 2026 — a late-September guidance raise to $410–420M would be consistent with that stated plan, but no primary source or press-wire confirmation was reached this session.

catalysts.headline: Iovance raises FY2026 total revenue guidance to $410-420M (from $350-370M) on strong Amtagvi and Proleukin commercial demand; shares surged
catalysts.impact: Stock up roughly 31.5% (one source) to 38.6% (another) intraday/close, continuing higher into 09-30; H.C. Wainwright raised its price target from $9 to $20

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: record product revenue $99.3M (+66% YoY), adjusted loss per share $0.11 (beat estimate by $0.02), gross margin improved to 56% from 41% in Q1

Iovance reported Q2 2026 results: total revenue ~$99M (+66% YoY), with US Amtagvi revenue ~$91M beating guidance and consensus; gross margin 56%; cash and equivalents $304M at quarter-end; said it was reviewing its FY2026 revenue guidance of $350M–$370M with an update expected during Q3 2026
catalysts.impact: Large beat; stock reportedly had its best single day in over six years amid 'buyout buzz' commentary

conflicts: Market cap: a Google Finance figure found this session cites ~$5.9B (undated, but consistent with the stock trading in the $12-15 range after the Sept 29 guidance raise) vs the $3.78B at $8.34/share (2026-08-21, pre-rally) already on file vs a separate $1.71B at $3.82/share (undated) — not reconciled; the spread largely reflects the stock's rally since the guidance raise rather than a single data error.
notes: Price updated to the most recent specific dated figure found this session ($12.96, 2026-10-06, Google Finance, -8.41% that day); an Oct 5 figure of $14.18 (AAII) suggests continued volatility this month. Per Stocktwits, Iovance is expected to present oral SARATOGA (soft-tissue sarcoma) trial data in 'late October 2026,' and a pivotal-study program update on a non-small-cell lung cancer program is due in Q4 2026 — both flagged as upcoming items without a confirmed date, not recorded as dated catalysts per the dated-catalyst rule.
